title: Shipping fees, carrier trace and delivery reporting windows for the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
The fulfilment standard of Larkfield's distribution centers for the Urology and Continence Supply Program sets, for each tier, the shipping fees, the carrier trace period, the courtesy reship allowance, the reporting windows for damaged or defective packages, and whether a signature is required on delivery.

## Terms

- **Standard shipping fee**: the fee, in USD, for standard ground shipping of a refill below the free-shipping threshold.
- **Free-shipping threshold**: the shipment cash-price total, in USD, at or above which standard shipping is free. A figure of 0.00 USD means standard shipping is always free.
- **Expedited shipping fee**: the fee, in USD, for customer-requested two-day shipping. It is never billed to a payer.
- **Carrier trace period**: the number of business days after the carrier's expected delivery date after which an undelivered package is declared lost in transit. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays.
- **Courtesy reships**: the number of no-charge courtesy reships per program for packages the carrier shows as delivered but the customer did not receive. They are counted over the rolling 12 months ending on the reship date.
- **Damage report window**: the window for reporting a package damaged in transit, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date.
- **Defect report window**: the window for reporting an item that was defective as shipped, in calendar days counted from the carrier delivery date. A defective item is one with the wrong French size, tip or product size, a broken sterile package, or a recalled lot.
- **Signature on delivery**: whether the carrier must obtain the customer's signature on delivery of a continence package.

## Standards

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard shipping fee | 6.95 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Free-shipping threshold | 75.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Expedited shipping fee | 24.50 USD | 24.50 USD | 24.50 USD | 24.50 USD | 24.50 USD | 24.50 USD |
| Carrier trace period (business days) | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Courtesy reships per rolling 12 months | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Damage report window (days) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Defect report window (days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Signature required on delivery | No | No | No | No | No | No |


## Points of reading

- Only the Continence Self-Pay Program charges for standard shipping. Its threshold of 75.00 USD is met at a cash-price total of exactly 75.00 USD. **Hypothetical shipments:** a 74.99 USD shipment pays the 6.95 USD fee, and a 75.00 USD shipment ships free.
- On every insured tier the standard fee and the threshold are both 0.00 USD, so standard ground shipping is free.
